title: Did the email of 3 May form a contract?
description: Law course notes: whether a contract was formed, with offer and acceptance as co-premises, an objection to the acceptance and its rebuttal.
claim: A binding contract was formed on 3 May

points.text: The quote was an offer capable of acceptance
The email asked for a later delivery date: a counter-offer
It asked whether the date could move: a mere enquiry
